 Savion Williams (ankle) will play Sunday 
 by Leo Sells | Packers Correspondent | Fri, Oct 23rd 2026, 4:24pm EDT 
 Savion Williams (ankle) will play in Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions. ( Rob Demovsky on Twitter ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Williams is going to be available to play on Sunday, despite managing an ankle injury earlier in the week. He isn't expected to see a lot of work against the Lions, however, though his workload will increase if Bo Melton (back) is ruled out ahead of game time.
 In addition to Zaire Franklin (shin) being ruled out, the Packers have listed four players as questionable:
Aaron Banks (knee/toe)
Benjamin St-Juste (hamstring)
Bo Melton (back)
Jordon Riley (Achilles)
No injury designations for Jordan Love (back), Matthew Golden (shoulder) or…
— Rob Demovsky (@RobDemovsky) October 23, 2026
